title: Elderly woman stabbed to death over debt in Laguna store; body set on fire
summary: A 67-year-old woman was found dead inside her sari-sari store after a fire broke out early Friday in Barangay Magdapio, Pagsanjan, in what police said was a murder disguised as a fire.
